problem: Nemotron Super kept 8360.0 MB of BF16 Mamba2 in_proj/out_proj projection weights resident, which limited startup free VRAM, long prefill calibration length, and HCS residency.
implemented_changes: Added a cached dense-backbone INT4 cache namespace for Mamba2 in_proj/out_proj projections, separate from HCS expert cache.
Cached both Marlin INT4 prefill payloads and matching simple INT4 decode payloads so prefill and decode consume the same quantized artifacts.
Registered cached projection artifacts through existing single-slot Marlin/simple INT4 descriptors and released BF16 projection tensors after registration.
Added config-derived Mamba2 SSD runtime-temp reserve to prefill budgeting after the freed VRAM allowed longer startup calibration probes.
Post-review hardening binds the projection cache manifest to the source model path, config/index contents, and source shard size/mtime metadata so stale same-shape cache reuse fails closed.
diagnostic_findings: The first startup diagnostic proved the projection cache path registered successfully but exposed missing Mamba2 SSD runtime-temp reservation when calibration grew to 15191 tokens.
The fixed planner reserved mamba2_runtime_reserve_mb=1955.6 at 15191 tokens and passed long calibration with min free 1512 MB.

A post-review startup diagnostic rebuilt the cache with source_signature=e8fc857ad12b271c221f52cdd0e8a9ee574f79a7a85125f142064a3cdcc1489f, reached KRASIS SERVER READY, and reproduced startup free 20232 MB and HCS 7084/20480 before pressure eviction.

The final timing-off run shows the change is a major VRAM/HCS/decode improvement, but not a substantial prefill-speed improvement; the next prefill target remains Mamba2 SSD/output scan and compute/runtime pressure.
